instruction: Update all my Spotify playlist titles with the most common song genre in that playlist in this format: "<original_title> | <most_common_genre>". Replace <original_title> and <most_common_genre> with the actual values.
notes: Single-app task. Reference solution uses 8 API calls, which implies the supervisor owns 2 playlists in her library (passwords, login, show_playlist_library, 2x(show_playlist, update_playlist), complete_task); the problem therefore instantiates playlist-1 and playlist-2. Playlist ids are discovered via show_playlist_library (modeled by the nullary knowledge fact library-listed plus static in-library facts); the most common genre per playlist is computed at runtime from the songs returned by show_playlist (modeled by genre-slot / found-most-common-genre), and the new title object is the runtime string '<original_title> | <most_common_genre>' (static derived-title link). update_playlist only passes title so no other playlist field changes, matching the evaluation. supervisor-complete-task takes the two updated playlists/titles as record parameters (no API arguments, task asks no question) and requires them to be distinct, so it can only fire once every playlist title has been updated. If show_playlist does not include song genres in the running environment, an additional spotify.show_song per song would be needed to derive the genre (not modeled, to match the reference call count).
